description: This Java class defines an Android activity for sending bug reports via email, including UI handling, intent creation, and report dispatching.

classes.name: SendBugReportUiActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for composing and sending bug reports via email, handling user interactions and report dispatch.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Retrieves bug report details from intent extras and updates UI; finishes activity if details are missing.

methods.name: onCancelCrashReport
methods.description: Handles user cancellation of bug report, finishing the activity.

methods.name: onSendCrashReport
methods.description: Disposes previous disposable, initiates report sending via LocalProxy.

methods.name: sendReportViaSend
methods.description: Creates an email intent with report details and attachment, launches email chooser, handles failure.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Disposes of resources when activity is destroyed.
